name: scatter-prints
title: Scatter Prints
description: A hero that deals photo prints behind the pointer. Each one flips in from the way you're moving and lands with a little give, and the page drifts toward the colour of the newest photo. Stop and the last few gather into a stack; click it and the top print grows into a full view. On a phone, a tap deals a small fan.
blurb: A trail of photo prints behind your cursor. Stop for a second and they gather into a stack.
note: move around, then stop for a second
